text: As a user, I want to see a summary of my order before confirming the purchase. The summary should display all items in the cart. The summary should include the user's address and payment details. The user should be able to confirm or cancel the order.

As a user, I want to view all the discs currently in my shopping cart. The system should display all items in the cart. Each item should show its title, artist, price, and quantity. The user should be able to remove items from the cart.
As a user, I should only have one active order in progress at a time. If the user has an active order, they cannot create a new one. Once the order is completed, the user can create a new one.

As a user, when I complete an order, it should no longer be in progress. When an order is completed, its status should change to 'completed'. The user should receive a confirmation of the completed order. The user should be able to place a new order after completion.

As a user, if I don't have a cart, the system should create one for me. If a user logs in without an existing cart, a new cart should be automatically created. The cart should be stored in the database. The user should be able to add items to the newly created cart.

As a user, I want to log in and be recognized in the system. The system should allow users to log in with valid credentials. If login is successful, the user is recognized and granted access to their account. If login fails, the system should provide an appropriate error message.

As a user, I want to register and log in using email or Google authentication, so I can access my account. User can register with an email and password. User can log in using registered credentials. User can log in via Google authentication.
As an admin, I want to add, edit, and delete products, so I can manage my store efficiently. Admin can create new product entries. Admin can update product details. Admin can delete a product.
As a user, I want to browse products by category, so I can find items easily. User can view a list of product categories. User can browse products filtered by category.

As a user, I want to add and remove products from my cart, so I can purchase what I need. User can add a product to their cart specifying a quantity. User can remove a product from their cart. User's cart updates in real-time.

As a user, I want to proceed to checkout and complete my payment, so I can receive my order. User can view their cart summary before checkout. User can proceed to payment. User receives an order confirmation after payment.

As a user, I want to leave reviews and ratings on products, so I can share my feedback with others. User can submit a rating (1-5 stars). User can leave a textual review. User's review is linked to the product.

As an admin, I want to add, update, and delete products, so I can manage my inventory. Admin can create a new product with a name, description, and price. Admin can update an existing product's details. Admin can delete a product.

As a customer, I want to place an order, so I can purchase products. Users can add products to an order using their SKU codes. Orders are stored in the system with an order number. Users receive a confirmation when an order is placed.
As a customer, I want to view my past orders, so I can track my purchases. Users can retrieve their past orders by order number. Orders include product details and prices.
